description: The fixed 24-point orbit-response panel of Section 4.2, frozen before the real-kernel runs.  Every arm is an exact rank-7 <2,2,2> decomposition in the canonical rebalanced gauge.  Rows of U, V and W are indexed by the seven products; each row is a 2x2 pattern flattened row-major.

groups.named: the certified Phi-optimum, the other DPS form, the two small rational forms, classic Strassen and Winograd
groups.perturb: twelve signed perturbations of the certified arm: three factors crossed with diagonal or shear directions and two signs
groups.disagree: three Gamma-tie / Phi-split pairs, the rival-hypothesis test
